question: The Maharashtra Bhushan was conferred upon ______________ in the year 2002.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Bhimsen Joshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Joshi** was an Indian vocalist in the Hindustani classical tradition, renowned for his khayal form singing as well as for his popular renditions of devotional music.
 
• He was awarded the **Maharashtra Bhushan** in 2002, which is one of the highest civilian awards presented by the Government of Maharashtra.
 
• Pandit Bhimsen Joshi was also the recipient of several other prestigious awards, including the **Bharat Ratna** in 2008, India's highest civilian honor.&
